description: Benchmark dataset for RAG pipeline evaluation. Questions span 15 categories. Ground truth must be verified against actual documents before use.
construction_methodology: Questions are constructed to test different retrieval and generation capabilities. Each question has a verified source document and page. Unanswerable questions have answers that do NOT exist in the documents. IMPORTANT: Synthetic questions are NOT automatically ground truth. Each question must be verified by a human annotator against the source documents. The answerable/unanswerable distinction must be confirmed manually.

categories.direct_lookup: Single-fact questions answerable from one passage
categories.multi_hop: Requires combining information from multiple passages
categories.numerical: Questions involving numbers, dates, or quantities
categories.comparison: Compare two or more concepts from the documents
categories.cross_section: Information spanning multiple sections of one document
categories.unanswerable: Answer does NOT exist in the documents
categories.adversarial: Designed to test hallucination resistance and prompt injection
categories.temporal: Questions about time sequences or changes over time
categories.long_context: Requires retrieving from deep in a large document
